crossRefs.note: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven…
I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he…
He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…
by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

translations.web: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
translations.bsb: And Abraham said, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord, suppose twenty are found there?” He answered, “On account of the twenty, I will not destroy it.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's
translations.asv: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for the twenty's sake.
